added: Sequential chapter downloads: finish one complete chapter before starting the next queued chapter.
Automatic rate-limit cooldown with up to three increasingly spaced resume attempts.
improved: Limit active manga sources and page requests to one at a time to reduce request bursts.
Respect HTTP 429 with 15, 30 and 60 minute cooldowns and stop automatic attempts if rate limits persist.
Retain saved page files, unfinished chapters, queue order and existing Android network and Wi-Fi restrictions.
fixed: Avoid overlapping chapter downloads and eliminate the need to manually resume after the first temporary HTTP 429 cooldown.
